rows.note: This is the everyday noun for a loud, bothersome noise.

example.english: The racket here is so loud I can't read.
example.traditional: 呢度啲嘈吵聲真係嘈到我睇唔到書。
example.jyutping: nei1 dou6 di1 cou4 caau2 sing1 zan1 hai6 cou4 dou3 ngo5 tai2 m4 dou2 syu1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a racket used to hit a ball or shuttlecock.

example.english: Remember to bring your racket when playing badminton.
example.jyutping: daa2 jyu5 mou4 kau4 gei3 dak1 daai3 kau4 paak3

rows.note: Use this for the fraud or swindle sense of a racket.

example.english: This racket has swindled many people.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 pin3 guk6 aak1 zo2 hou2 do1 jan4

rows.note: Use this for a racket as an illicit profit-making operation rather than a single con.

example.english: They make money through an illegal racket.
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 kaau3 fei1 faat3 gau1 dong3 zaan6 cin2
